The '''Grappler 213''' was a [[Tractor beam projector/Legends|tractor beam projector]] manufactured by [[Sienar Fleet Systems/Legends|Sienar Fleet Systems]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] and cost 6,200 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. It was used to reduce the maneuverability of an enemy ship.<ref name="DC" />
